description: This Scala source file defines the ErrorUtils object for error handling in Spark Connect, including converting exceptions to protobuf responses, building gRPC status objects, and handling errors in RPC calls.

methods.name: allClasses
methods.description: Recursively collects all classes in the hierarchy of a given class.

methods.name: throwableToFetchErrorDetailsResponse
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a FetchErrorDetailsResponse protobuf message, including error chain and optional stack trace.

methods.name: buildStatusFromThrowable
methods.description: Creates a gRPC RPCStatus object from a Throwable, including error metadata and optional stack trace.

methods.name: isPythonExecutionException
methods.description: Checks if a SparkException is caused by a Python execution error.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions in RPC methods, logs errors, reports to ExecuteEventsManager, and sends error responses via StreamObserver.
